headline: Executive order assigns foreign affairs duties, including running two debt-relief programs tied to Latin America and tropical forest protection.
what_it_does: The order assigns certain foreign affairs responsibilities to federal agencies or officials. Based on its title, it sets out who carries out the Enterprise for the Americas Initiative and the Tropical Forest Conservation Act. These laws allow the U.S. to reduce or restructure debts owed by eligible foreign countries, often in exchange for funding environmental or forest conservation. No summary was provided, so the specific assignments are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies handling foreign affairs and debt programs
who_it_affects.how: They receive or have clarified responsibilities for carrying out these programs.

who_it_affects.group: Eligible developing countries, especially in Latin America and the Caribbean and those with tropical forests
who_it_affects.how: Their debt-relief and conservation agreements with the U.S. are handled by the officials this order designates.

when_it_takes_effect: 2004-07-08 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in the source)
